info.title: Reject Cancellation
info.description: Use this API to reject a buyer's cancellation request for the specified cancel_id. Before calling this API, make sure the request is still in a state where seller rejection is currently allowed.

post.description: Use this API to reject a buyer's cancellation request for the specified cancel_id. Before calling this API, make sure the request is still in a state where seller rejection is currently allowed.

parameters.name: shop_cipher
parameters.description: Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response.

parameters.name: app_key
parameters.description: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

parameters.name: idempotency_key
parameters.description: The idempotency key is a unique value generated by the client which the server uses to recognize a request.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Request body. Full source table is retained in x-tiktok-request-body-parameters.

reject_reason.description: Seller's reason for rejecting the buyer's order cancellation request. Use the [Get Decision Eligibility](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/69844a11eeba77049695c7f6) endpoint to retrieve the currently available rejection reasons for the same cancellation request, and submit the returned rejection reason name in this field.

comment.description: Seller's comment on rejection decision. This is where a seller will provide more information about rejecting the request.
comment.example: I have packed the products before cancellation request

images.description: List of images provided by the seller to support seller's decision to reject the order cancellation request.

200.description: Successful response. See source Markdown for complete semantics.
